site.description: Free PDF tools that run entirely in your browser: merge, split, compress, rotate, convert and protect PDFs. Your files never leave your device. No sign-up, no watermark.
site.homeTitle: Free PDF Tools That Never Upload Your Files
site.homeLead: Merge, split, compress and convert PDFs right in your browser. Free, private, and nothing ever leaves your device.
site.privateH2: Private by design, not by promise
site.privateP1: Most online PDF services upload your document to their servers, process it there, and ask you to trust that it is deleted afterwards. Scissor PDF works differently: the PDF engine itself is downloaded to your browser, written in Rust and compiled to WebAssembly, and every merge, split or compression happens on your own device.
site.privateP2: That makes it suitable for contracts, medical records, tax forms and anything else you would rather not hand to a stranger. See how it works and how to verify it yourself.
site.whySwitch: Why people switch to Scissor PDF

footer.note: Scissor PDF processes every file in your browser with a Rust engine compiled to WebAssembly. No uploads, no accounts, no tracking.

common.noscript: This tool runs in your browser and needs JavaScript and WebAssembly enabled.
common.f1p: Files are processed in your browser tab and never uploaded. There is no server that could see, keep or leak them.
common.f2p: A PDF engine written in Rust runs as WebAssembly at near-native speed. After the first visit it works without a connection.
common.f3p: No sign-up, no daily limits, no watermark, no ads. Open the page, drop your file, download the result.

merge-pdf.name: Merge PDF
merge-pdf.short: Combine several PDFs into one file, in the order you choose.
merge-pdf.title: Merge PDF Files Free, Without Uploading
merge-pdf.description: Combine PDF files into one document in your browser. Drag to reorder, then merge. Files are never uploaded. Free, no sign-up, no watermark.
merge-pdf.lead: Combine several PDFs into one document, in the order you want. Everything happens on your device, so even confidential files stay private.
steps: Choose or drop the PDF files you want to combine. You can add more at any time.
Drag the files into the order they should appear in the final document.
Select Merge PDFs, then download the combined file.

sections.h: What is kept when you merge
sections.p: Every page keeps its original size, orientation, text, images, links and fillable form fields. Bookmarks from the first document are kept. The merged file is a standard PDF that opens in any reader, including Preview, Adobe Acrobat and every web browser.

There is no limit on the number of files or pages. Very large documents are limited only by your device's memory. A modern laptop handles several hundred megabytes comfortably. If a merged file turns out bigger than you need, run it through Compress PDF afterwards.

faqs.q: Are my files uploaded when I merge PDFs?
faqs.a: No. Scissor PDF runs a PDF engine written in Rust and compiled to WebAssembly inside your browser tab. Your files are read from your disk into the page's memory, processed there and saved back to your device. The site has no upload endpoint, and its Content Security Policy blocks the page from sending data to any other server.

faqs.q: How do I change the order of the files?
faqs.a: Drag any file card to a new position before you merge. The final document follows the order of the cards from left to right, top to bottom.

faqs.q: Can I merge only some pages of a PDF?
faqs.a: Merge combines whole documents. To use only some pages, open the file in Extract pages first, then merge the result. Or merge everything and remove pages with Delete pages.

faqs.q: Can I merge password-protected PDFs?
faqs.a: Remove the password with Unlock PDF first (you need to know it), then merge.

faqs.q: Is it free? Do I need an account?
faqs.a: It is free, with no account, no daily task limit and no watermark added to your documents. Because the work happens on your own computer, there is no server cost per file for us to recover.

split-pdf.name: Split PDF
split-pdf.short: Cut a PDF into several files by page ranges or every few pages.
split-pdf.title: Split PDF Free, Without Uploading
split-pdf.description: Split a PDF into separate files by page ranges, every N pages or one file per page. Runs in your browser, so files are never uploaded. Free, no sign-up.
split-pdf.lead: Cut one PDF into several smaller files: by custom page ranges, into equal parts, or one file per page. Your document never leaves your device.
steps: Choose or drop the PDF you want to split.
Pick how to split it: custom ranges such as 1-3, 4-10, a fixed number of pages per file, or every page on its own.
Select Split PDF. You get one PDF, or a ZIP archive when the split produces several files.

sections.p: Custom ranges give you full control: type 1-5, 6-12, 13 to get three files. Fixed size cuts the document into parts of the same length, which is handy for scanned batches. Every page produces one PDF per page.
Split divides the whole document into several files. To pull just a few pages out into one new file, Extract pages is quicker.

faqs.q: Are my files uploaded when I split a PDF?
faqs.a: No. Scissor PDF runs a PDF engine written in Rust and compiled to WebAssembly inside your browser tab. Your files are read from your disk into the page's memory, processed there and saved back to your device. The site has no upload endpoint, and its Content Security Policy blocks the page from sending data to any other server.

faqs.q: How do I write page ranges?
faqs.a: Separate ranges with commas. Use a hyphen for a range and a single number for one page, for example 1-3, 5, 8-12. Each range becomes its own PDF.

faqs.q: Why do I get a ZIP file?
faqs.a: When a split produces more than one PDF, they are packed into a single ZIP so you only download once. Every operating system opens ZIP files with a double-click.

faqs.q: Does splitting reduce quality?
faqs.a: No. Pages are copied as they are, without re-rendering, so text stays sharp and searchable and images are untouched.

faqs.q: Is it free? Do I need an account?
faqs.a: It is free, with no account, no daily task limit and no watermark added to your documents. Because the work happens on your own computer, there is no server cost per file for us to recover.

compress-pdf.name: Compress PDF
compress-pdf.short: Make a PDF smaller for email and uploads, with quality you choose.
compress-pdf.title: Compress PDF Free, Without Uploading
compress-pdf.description: Reduce PDF file size in your browser. Choose lossless, recommended or strong compression. Files are never uploaded. Free, no sign-up, no watermark.
compress-pdf.lead: Shrink a PDF so it fits email limits and upload forms. Choose how hard to compress, and see exactly how much smaller the file became. Nothing is uploaded.
steps: Choose or drop the PDF you want to make smaller.
Pick a level: Lossless keeps every pixel, Recommended balances size and quality, Strong makes the smallest file.
Select Compress PDF, check the new size, and download.

sections.p: Every level removes unused objects, packs the file structure into compressed object streams and compresses any uncompressed data. Recommended and Strong also re-encode large photos as JPEG and scale down images larger than needed for screen and office printing: up to 2200 pixels on the long side for Recommended, 1400 for Strong. Text and vector graphics are never rasterised, so they stay sharp and searchable.

Scanned documents and PDFs full of photos usually shrink the most, often by 70 to 95 percent. PDFs that are mostly text are already compact and may shrink only a little. If the result is not smaller, the original was already well optimised.

faqs.q: Are my files uploaded when I compress a PDF?
faqs.a: No. Scissor PDF runs a PDF engine written in Rust and compiled to WebAssembly inside your browser tab. Your files are read from your disk into the page's memory, processed there and saved back to your device. The site has no upload endpoint, and its Content Security Policy blocks the page from sending data to any other server.

faqs.q: Which compression level should I choose?
faqs.a: Start with Recommended. It typically cuts photo-heavy PDFs by more than half while staying sharp on screen and in print. Use Strong when you must get under a strict size limit, and Lossless when the images must not change at all.

faqs.q: Will the text in my PDF become blurry?
faqs.a: No. Only embedded photos are re-encoded. Text, fonts and vector drawings are kept exactly as they were.

faqs.q: How do I get a PDF under 1 MB or 2 MB for an upload form?
faqs.a: Try Strong compression. If it is still too big, split the document with Split PDF, or remove pages you do not need with Delete pages, then compress again.

faqs.q: Is it free? Do I need an account?
faqs.a: It is free, with no account, no daily task limit and no watermark added to your documents. Because the work happens on your own computer, there is no server cost per file for us to recover.

organize-pdf.name: Organize PDF
organize-pdf.short: Reorder, rotate and delete pages in one visual editor.
organize-pdf.title: Reorder, Rotate & Delete PDF Pages
organize-pdf.description: Rearrange PDF pages by dragging, rotate or delete individual pages, then save. Runs entirely in your browser, files are never uploaded. Free, no sign-up.
organize-pdf.lead: See every page as a thumbnail, then drag to reorder, rotate the ones that are sideways and remove the ones you do not need. Your file stays on your device.
steps: Choose or drop a PDF. Every page appears as a thumbnail.
Drag pages into a new order. Use the buttons on each page to rotate or delete it.
Select Save PDF to download the reorganised document.

sections.p: Organize combines reordering, rotating and deleting, so you can fix a scanned document in one pass. Changes are only applied when you save, and the original file on your disk is never modified.
Pages can be dragged with a mouse, a trackpad or a finger. Each page also has buttons to move it earlier or later, which is precise for long documents.

faqs.q: Are my files uploaded when I organize a PDF?
faqs.a: No. Scissor PDF runs a PDF engine written in Rust and compiled to WebAssembly inside your browser tab. Your files are read from your disk into the page's memory, processed there and saved back to your device. The site has no upload endpoint, and its Content Security Policy blocks the page from sending data to any other server.

faqs.q: Can I undo a change?
faqs.a: Yes. Select a deleted page again to restore it, rotate a page back, or use Reset to return to the original order before you save.

faqs.q: Does reordering affect links and bookmarks?
faqs.a: Links between pages that stay in the document keep working. Bookmarks and links pointing to deleted pages are removed so the file has no broken references.

faqs.q: Can I add pages from another PDF?
faqs.a: Use Merge PDF to combine the files first, then open the merged file here to put pages in order.

faqs.q: Is it free? Do I need an account?
faqs.a: It is free, with no account, no daily task limit and no watermark added to your documents. Because the work happens on your own computer, there is no server cost per file for us to recover.

rotate-pdf.name: Rotate PDF
rotate-pdf.short: Turn sideways or upside-down pages the right way up.
rotate-pdf.title: Rotate PDF Pages Free, Without Uploading
rotate-pdf.description: Rotate all pages or single pages of a PDF by 90 or 180 degrees and save the result permanently. Runs in your browser, nothing is uploaded. Free.
rotate-pdf.lead: Fix pages that are sideways or upside down. Rotate the whole document or individual pages, then save. The rotation is stored in the file, so it stays fixed in every reader.
steps: Choose or drop the PDF to rotate.
Rotate every page at once with the buttons above the pages, or select the rotate button on a single page.
Select Save PDF and download the corrected file.

sections.p: Rotation changes the page's orientation setting rather than redrawing its content, so text and images keep their full quality and the file size stays the same.

faqs.q: Are my files uploaded when I rotate a PDF?
faqs.a: No. Scissor PDF runs a PDF engine written in Rust and compiled to WebAssembly inside your browser tab. Your files are read from your disk into the page's memory, processed there and saved back to your device. The site has no upload endpoint, and its Content Security Policy blocks the page from sending data to any other server.

faqs.q: Is the rotation saved permanently?
faqs.a: Yes. The new orientation is written into the PDF, so it opens the right way in Preview, Acrobat, browsers and on phones.

faqs.q: Can I rotate only one page?
faqs.a: Yes. Every thumbnail has its own rotate button. Pages you do not touch keep their current orientation.

faqs.q: Is it free? Do I need an account?
faqs.a: It is free, with no account, no daily task limit and no watermark added to your documents. Because the work happens on your own computer, there is no server cost per file for us to recover.

delete-pdf-pages.name: Delete pages
delete-pdf-pages.short: Remove blank, duplicate or unwanted pages from a PDF.
delete-pdf-pages.title: Delete PDF Pages Free, Without Uploading
delete-pdf-pages.description: Remove pages from a PDF by clicking them or typing page numbers. Runs entirely in your browser, files are never uploaded. Free, no sign-up, no watermark.
delete-pdf-pages.lead: Click the pages you want to remove, or type their numbers, then save a new PDF without them. Your original file is not changed and never leaves your device.
steps: Choose or drop the PDF.
Click each page you want to remove, or type page numbers such as 2, 5-7.
Select Delete pages and download the new PDF.

sections.h: A smaller file, not just hidden pages
sections.p: Deleted pages are removed together with any images and fonts only they used, so the new file is genuinely smaller. Links and bookmarks that pointed at removed pages are cleaned up.

faqs.q: Are my files uploaded when I delete pages?
faqs.a: No. Scissor PDF runs a PDF engine written in Rust and compiled to WebAssembly inside your browser tab. Your files are read from your disk into the page's memory, processed there and saved back to your device. The site has no upload endpoint, and its Content Security Policy blocks the page from sending data to any other server.

faqs.q: Can I delete several pages at once?
faqs.a: Yes. Click as many pages as you like, or type a list such as 1, 4-6, 10.

faqs.q: Can I get a deleted page back?
faqs.a: Before saving, click it again to keep it. After saving, your original file is still on your device unchanged.

faqs.q: Is it free? Do I need an account?
faqs.a: It is free, with no account, no daily task limit and no watermark added to your documents. Because the work happens on your own computer, there is no server cost per file for us to recover.

extract-pdf-pages.name: Extract pages
extract-pdf-pages.short: Pull selected pages out of a PDF into a new document.
extract-pdf-pages.title: Extract PDF Pages Free, Without Uploading
extract-pdf-pages.description: Select pages from a PDF and save them as a new file, or as separate files per page. Runs in your browser, nothing is uploaded. Free, no sign-up.
extract-pdf-pages.lead: Pick the pages you need and save them as a new PDF, or as one file per page. The source document stays untouched and on your device.
steps: Choose or drop the PDF.
Click the pages to extract, or type them, for example 3, 7-9.
Choose one combined PDF or one file per page, then select Extract pages.

sections.p: Extracted pages are copied, not re-printed, so text stays selectable and searchable and images keep their original resolution.

faqs.q: Are my files uploaded when I extract pages?
faqs.a: No. Scissor PDF runs a PDF engine written in Rust and compiled to WebAssembly inside your browser tab. Your files are read from your disk into the page's memory, processed there and saved back to your device. The site has no upload endpoint, and its Content Security Policy blocks the page from sending data to any other server.

faqs.q: Can I save each page as its own PDF?
faqs.a: Yes. Choose "One file per page" before extracting. You receive a ZIP archive with a PDF for every selected page.

faqs.q: What is the difference from Split PDF?
faqs.a: Extract creates a file from the pages you pick. Split divides the entire document into several parts.

faqs.q: Is it free? Do I need an account?
faqs.a: It is free, with no account, no daily task limit and no watermark added to your documents. Because the work happens on your own computer, there is no server cost per file for us to recover.

jpg-to-pdf.name: JPG to PDF
jpg-to-pdf.short: Turn photos and scans (JPG, PNG, HEIC, WebP) into a PDF.
jpg-to-pdf.title: JPG to PDF: Convert Images Free, No Upload
jpg-to-pdf.description: Convert JPG, PNG, WebP and HEIC images to one PDF in your browser. Reorder, choose page size and margins. Photos are never uploaded. Free, no sign-up.
jpg-to-pdf.lead: Turn photos, screenshots and scanned pages into a single PDF. JPEGs are embedded at their original quality, and nothing is uploaded.
steps: Choose or drop your images: JPG, PNG, WebP, GIF, or HEIC on Safari.
Drag them into order and choose a page size: fit to the image, A4 or US Letter, with or without a margin.
Select Create PDF and download.

sections.p: JPEG photos are placed in the PDF byte for byte, without re-compression, so there is no quality loss. Phone photos are turned upright using their orientation data. PNG and other formats are stored losslessly, including transparency.

Fit makes each page the same shape as its image, which is best for photos and screenshots. A4 and Letter place each image centred on standard paper, turning the page to landscape for wide images, which is best for documents you will print.

faqs.q: Are my files uploaded when I convert images to PDF?

Your files are read from your disk into the page's memory, processed there and saved back to your device. The site has no upload endpoint, and its Content Security Policy blocks the page from sending data to any other server.

faqs.q: Can I convert iPhone HEIC photos?
faqs.a: Yes in Safari, which can read HEIC natively. In other browsers, share the photo as JPEG from the Photos app first, or open this page in Safari.

faqs.q: How many images can I add?
faqs.a: As many as your device's memory allows. Hundreds of photos are fine on a typical laptop.

faqs.q: Will the PDF be large?
faqs.a: About the size of your images combined. To make it smaller, run the result through Compress PDF.

faqs.q: Is it free? Do I need an account?
faqs.a: It is free, with no account, no daily task limit and no watermark added to your documents. Because the work happens on your own computer, there is no server cost per file for us to recover.

jpg-to-pdf.howTo: How to convert JPG to PDF

pdf-to-jpg.name: PDF to JPG
pdf-to-jpg.short: Save PDF pages as high-quality JPG or PNG images.
pdf-to-jpg.title: PDF to JPG: Convert Pages Free, No Upload
pdf-to-jpg.description: Convert every page of a PDF, or selected pages, to JPG or PNG images at the resolution you choose. Runs in your browser, nothing uploaded. Free.
pdf-to-jpg.lead: Save PDF pages as sharp JPG or PNG images, ready for slides, social posts or chat. Choose the pages and resolution. Rendering happens on your device.
steps: Choose or drop the PDF.
Select the pages to convert (all by default), the format and the resolution.
Select Convert to images. One page downloads as an image, several come as a ZIP.

sections.p: Standard (108 DPI) suits screens and messaging. High (144 DPI) is sharp on high-resolution displays and in presentations. Print (216 DPI) is for printing and zooming in on detail.
JPG makes smaller files and suits pages with photos. PNG is lossless and keeps text and line art crisp, at a larger size.

faqs.q: Are my files uploaded when I convert a PDF to images?

Your files are read from your disk into the page's memory, processed there and saved back to your device. The site has no upload endpoint, and its Content Security Policy blocks the page from sending data to any other server.

faqs.q: Can I convert just one page?
faqs.a: Yes. Deselect all, click the page you want, and convert. A single page downloads directly as an image, without a ZIP.

faqs.q: Which renderer is used?
faqs.a: Pages are drawn by PDF.js, the open-source PDF renderer built into Firefox, running locally in your browser.

faqs.q: Is it free? Do I need an account?
faqs.a: It is free, with no account, no daily task limit and no watermark added to your documents. Because the work happens on your own computer, there is no server cost per file for us to recover.

add-page-numbers.name: Page numbers
add-page-numbers.short: Number the pages of a PDF, in the position and style you choose.
add-page-numbers.title: Add Page Numbers to PDF Free, No Upload
add-page-numbers.description: Add page numbers to a PDF: choose position, format such as "Page 1 of 10", start number and first page. Runs in your browser, nothing uploaded. Free.
add-page-numbers.h1: Add page numbers to a PDF
add-page-numbers.lead: Number your pages in seconds. Choose where the numbers go, how they read and where counting starts. Everything runs on your device.
steps: Choose or drop the PDF.
Pick a position, a format such as "1" or "Page 1 of 12", the first page to number and the starting number.
Select Add page numbers and download.

sections.h: Works with rotated and mixed-size pages
sections.p: Numbers are placed on the edge you actually see, so landscape and rotated pages are numbered the right way up, and mixed paper sizes each get correctly positioned numbers.
Set "Start on page" to 2 to leave a cover unnumbered, and set the starting number to 1 so numbering begins on the first page of content.

faqs.q: Are my files uploaded when I add page numbers?
faqs.a: No. Scissor PDF runs a PDF engine written in Rust and compiled to WebAssembly inside your browser tab. Your files are read from your disk into the page's memory, processed there and saved back to your device. The site has no upload endpoint, and its Content Security Policy blocks the page from sending data to any other server.

faqs.q: Can I use "Page X of Y"?
faqs.a: Yes. Choose the "Page 1 of 12" format. The total counts only the pages that receive a number.

faqs.q: Which font is used?
faqs.a: Helvetica, a standard PDF font every reader can display, in dark grey at the size you pick.

faqs.q: Is it free? Do I need an account?
faqs.a: It is free, with no account, no daily task limit and no watermark added to your documents. Because the work happens on your own computer, there is no server cost per file for us to recover.

watermark-pdf.name: Watermark PDF
watermark-pdf.short: Stamp text such as CONFIDENTIAL or DRAFT across every page.
watermark-pdf.title: Add a Watermark to PDF Free, No Upload
watermark-pdf.description: Add a text watermark like CONFIDENTIAL or DRAFT to every PDF page. Set size, angle, opacity and colour, single or tiled. Nothing uploaded. Free.
watermark-pdf.h1: Add a watermark to a PDF
watermark-pdf.lead: Mark documents as Confidential, Draft or with your name. Choose the text, colour, size, angle and transparency, once per page or tiled. Your PDF stays on your device.
steps: Choose or drop the PDF.
Type the watermark text and adjust colour, size, angle and opacity. The preview updates as you go.
Select Add watermark and download.

sections.p: The watermark is drawn with your system's fonts, so it works in every language, including Arabic, Kurdish, Chinese and emoji, and it looks the same in every PDF reader.
A single watermark sits in the middle of each page. Tiled repeats it across the page, which makes it much harder to crop out of screenshots.

faqs.q: Are my files uploaded when I watermark a PDF?
faqs.a: No. Scissor PDF runs a PDF engine written in Rust and compiled to WebAssembly inside your browser tab. Your files are read from your disk into the page's memory, processed there and saved back to your device. The site has no upload endpoint, and its Content Security Policy blocks the page from sending data to any other server.

faqs.q: Can the watermark be removed?
faqs.a: It is drawn into each page as an image layer. Someone with PDF editing software could still remove it, so for documents that must not be altered, also use Protect PDF.

faqs.q: Will the watermark hide my text?
faqs.a: Not if you keep opacity low. 15 to 30 percent keeps the document readable while the mark stays clearly visible.

faqs.q: Is it free? Do I need an account?
faqs.a: It is free, with no account, no daily task limit and no watermark added to your documents. Because the work happens on your own computer, there is no server cost per file for us to recover.

watermark-pdf.howTo: How to add a watermark to a PDF

protect-pdf.name: Protect PDF
protect-pdf.short: Add a password with AES-256 encryption.
protect-pdf.title: Password Protect PDF (AES-256), No Upload
protect-pdf.description: Encrypt a PDF with a password using AES-256, and optionally block printing or copying. Runs in your browser, the file and password never leave your device.
protect-pdf.lead: Encrypt a PDF so it can only be opened with your password. Encryption runs on your device, so neither the document nor the password is ever sent anywhere.
steps: Choose or drop the PDF.
Type a password and confirm it. Optionally prevent printing or copying text.
Select Protect PDF and download the encrypted file.

sections.p: Files are encrypted with AES-256, the strongest encryption in the PDF standard (PDF 2.0, security handler revision 6). Acrobat, Preview, Chrome, Edge and Firefox can all open them with the password.

sections.h: Choose a password you will remember
sections.p: There is no way to recover a forgotten password, not even for us, because we never see it. Use a long passphrase and keep it in a password manager.

faqs.q: Are my files uploaded when I protect a PDF?
faqs.a: No. Scissor PDF runs a PDF engine written in Rust and compiled to WebAssembly inside your browser tab. Your files are read from your disk into the page's memory, processed there and saved back to your device. The site has no upload endpoint, and its Content Security Policy blocks the page from sending data to any other server.

faqs.q: What do the print and copy options do?
faqs.a: They set permission flags that well-behaved PDF readers respect after the document is opened. They are restrictions, not encryption of their own, so treat the open password as the real protection.

faqs.q: Can I remove the password later?
faqs.a: Yes, with Unlock PDF, as long as you know the password.

faqs.q: Is it free? Do I need an account?
faqs.a: It is free, with no account, no daily task limit and no watermark added to your documents. Because the work happens on your own computer, there is no server cost per file for us to recover.

protect-pdf.howTo: How to password protect a PDF

unlock-pdf.name: Unlock PDF
unlock-pdf.short: Remove a password you know from a PDF.
unlock-pdf.title: Remove PDF Password Free, No Upload
unlock-pdf.description: Remove the password and restrictions from a PDF you have the password for. Runs in your browser, the file and password never leave your device.
unlock-pdf.h1: Remove a password from a PDF
unlock-pdf.lead: Tired of typing the password every time? Enter it once and save an unlocked copy. Decryption happens on your device. This tool cannot guess or crack unknown passwords.
steps: Choose or drop the protected PDF.
Type its password.
Select Unlock PDF and download a copy that opens without a password.

sections.p: Files that open freely but block printing, copying or editing are unlocked without any password: the restrictions are simply dropped from the saved copy. Only remove restrictions from documents you are entitled to use that way.

faqs.q: Are my files uploaded when I unlock a PDF?
faqs.a: No. Scissor PDF runs a PDF engine written in Rust and compiled to WebAssembly inside your browser tab. Your files are read from your disk into the page's memory, processed there and saved back to your device. The site has no upload endpoint, and its Content Security Policy blocks the page from sending data to any other server.

faqs.q: I forgot the password. Can you recover it?
faqs.a: No. Unlock PDF only removes a password you already know. It does not attempt to crack passwords.

faqs.q: Which encryption types are supported?
faqs.a: The standard PDF security handlers: RC4 40-bit and 128-bit, AES-128 and AES-256. Certificate-based encryption is not supported.

faqs.q: Is it free? Do I need an account?
faqs.a: It is free, with no account, no daily task limit and no watermark added to your documents. Because the work happens on your own computer, there is no server cost per file for us to recover.

unlock-pdf.howTo: How to remove a password from a PDF

sign-pdf.name: Sign PDF
sign-pdf.short: Draw, type or upload your signature and place it on any page.
sign-pdf.title: Sign PDF Free, Without Uploading
sign-pdf.description: Sign a PDF in your browser: draw, type or upload your signature, place it on any page, and download. The document never leaves your device.
sign-pdf.lead: Draw your signature with a finger or mouse, type it, or use a photo of it. Place it anywhere, resize it, and download the signed PDF. Nothing is uploaded.
steps: Choose or drop the PDF you need to sign.
Create your signature: draw it, type your name in a handwriting style, or upload a photo of it.
Drag it into place, resize it with the blue handle, add the date if needed, then select Sign PDF.

sections.h: Three ways to create a signature
sections.p: Draw it on screen, which works especially well with a finger or an Apple Pencil. Type your name and pick a handwriting style. Or upload a photo of your signature on white paper: the paper is made transparent so only the ink appears on the document.

sections.h: What kind of signature this is
sections.p: Scissor PDF adds a visual signature, the same as signing a printout and scanning it. It does not add a certificate-based digital signature. That is accepted for most everyday documents such as forms, rental agreements and permission slips; check the requirements when a document asks for a qualified or certified electronic signature.

faqs.q: Are my files uploaded when I sign a PDF?

how.title: How Scissor PDF Edits PDFs Without Uploading Them
how.description: Scissor PDF runs a Rust PDF engine compiled to WebAssembly inside your browser. Learn how local processing works and how to verify that no file is uploaded.
how.lead: Your browser downloads the PDF engine, not the other way round. Here is what happens when you use a tool, and how you can check it yourself.
how.body:
The short version

Scissor PDF never receives your files. When you open a tool, your browser downloads the website and a PDF engine. When you choose a file, it is read into the memory of your browser tab, processed by that engine on your own processor, and the result is handed back to you as a download. Closing the tab erases everything.

What runs where

The PDF engine that merges, splits, reorders, rotates, compresses, numbers, watermarks, encrypts and decrypts PDFs is written in Rust, using the open-source lopdf library, and compiled to WebAssembly. WebAssembly is a sandboxed format every modern browser runs at close to native speed. It runs in a background worker so the page stays responsive.

Page previews and PDF to JPG use PDF.js, the open-source renderer built into Firefox, also running locally.

The server is a plain static file host. It has no upload endpoint, no database and no application code, so there is nothing that could accept a document.

Verify it yourself

Open your browser's developer tools, switch to the Network tab and use any tool. You will see the page's own files load, and no request carrying your document. You can also disconnect from the internet after the page has loaded: every tool keeps working.

The site also sends a strict Content Security Policy that tells your browser to block the page from contacting any other server, so even a mistake in our code could not send your files elsewhere.

Works offline, installs like an app

After your first visit, a service worker stores the site and engine in your browser's cache, so the tools open and work with no connection. In Chrome or Edge, choose Install from the address bar. In Safari, choose Add to Dock (Mac) or Add to Home Screen (iPhone and iPad).

Limits of local processing

Because the work happens on your device, very large files are limited by its memory. Several hundred megabytes are fine on a typical laptop, and phones handle everyday documents. Speed depends on your processor rather than on a server queue, which in practice is usually faster than uploading and downloading.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.description: Scissor PDF does not upload, store or see your files. No accounts, no analytics cookies, no tracking. Read the full privacy policy.
privacy.lead: Short, because there is little to say: we never receive your documents.
privacy.body:
Your files

Files you open in Scissor PDF are processed entirely in your browser and are never transmitted to us or to anyone else. We cannot see, store, share or recover them.

Passwords

Passwords you type into Protect PDF or Unlock PDF are used only in your browser to encrypt or decrypt the file, and are never transmitted or stored.

What our server sees

Like any website, our server and content delivery network receive standard request information when your browser downloads the site's pages and files: IP address, requested address, time, and browser user agent. This is used only to operate and secure the service and to count aggregate traffic, and is not combined with other data or sold.

Cookies and tracking

Scissor PDF sets no cookies of its own and uses no advertising trackers. Your browser stores the site's files for offline use, and may keep a file briefly in local storage when you choose "Continue with" to pass a result to another tool; it is removed as soon as the next tool opens it.

Contact

Questions about privacy: see scissor.studio.
